cli.update_daemons.incomplete_heading.role: lop update closing warning (stderr): the install succeeded but one or more background services still run the previous build
cli.update_daemons.incomplete_heading.note: Lowercase start like the command's other warnings; ends with a colon because one indented row per service follows. Must not read as a failure of the install itself, only of the services moving.

cli.update_daemons.incomplete_row.role: lop update: one row under the heading, naming a service and what to run
cli.update_daemons.incomplete_row.note: {name} is a service's display name (e.g. 'network relay'), {remedy} is an already-localized-or-technical sentence ending in a literal command in backticks; keep both placeholders and the two leading spaces verbatim.

cli.update_daemons.remedy_fallback.role: lop update: remedy shown when no specific command is known for that service
cli.update_daemons.remedy_fallback.note: `lop services status` is a literal CLI command; keep it and its backticks verbatim.
